01

A front-end preview

VYBEORA is an illustrative music academy website. Names, studio availability, instructor profiles, fees, milestones, classes and notifications are examples, not live service records.

02

What stays in your browser

Theme, layout direction, sample enrollment choices, a demo payment marker, notification read status and an optional display name/email may be stored on your device. No account password or payment card details are stored.

03

Forms, videos and images

Forms demonstrate interface behaviour without submitting to a real academy. Generated artwork is served with this website. The optional contact map is provided by Google Maps and may use its own cookies or collect connection data when loaded.

04

Before any real launch

A live academy would need verified contact details, secure authentication, a real payment processor, accurate privacy terms, and appropriate access controls. This preview does not include those connections.
